subject: *: optimize error generation, debug log and AllocHandle in the hot write path (#54308)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent with focus on executor/session/table write path behavior: (1) `pkg/table/tables/tables.go` narrows `tables.AllocHandle` return type to `kv.IntHandle` while still always allocating `_tidb_rowid` as an int handle; callers can still pass it where `kv.Handle` is required with no semantic change. (2) `pkg/meta/autoid/autoid.go` wraps allocator debug logging with a debug-level check and uses `logutil.BgLogger()` (equivalent to previous `Logger(context.TODO())`), affecting only observability/perf. (3) `pkg/executor/batch_checker.go` replaces `fmt.Sprintf` with string concatenation for the same `table.index` key name in duplicate-key errors. Benchmarks/tests only additions in `pkg/session/bench_test.go` and a minor test adjustment in `pkg/table/tables/tables_test.go`. No plausible Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, data consistency, concurrency, or txn/session behavior; later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up changes specifically correcting these hunks.
